en: Saturday and Sunday, the days when most people do not work or go to school.
ex: We usually go hiking at the weekend.
我們通常在週末去健行。

en: The power to decide what happens; or to make someone or something do what you want; or a device that operates a machine.
ex: The teacher could not control the noisy class.
老師管不住吵鬧的班級。

en: A person who creates paintings, drawings or other works of art.
ex: The artist painted a picture of the mountains.
那位藝術家畫了一幅群山的畫。

en: A path at the side of a road where people walk.
ex: Children should walk on the sidewalk, not on the road.
孩子們應該走人行道，不要走馬路。

en: A piece of cloth with a pattern or color that represents a country or a group; or to mark something for attention.
ex: The students raised the flag every Monday morning.
學生們每星期一早上升旗。

en: A person you do an activity with, such as dancing; or someone you are in a relationship with; or someone who owns a business with you.
ex: She works with a partner at a design firm.
她和一位夥伴在一家設計公司工作。

en: Extremely large in size or amount.
ex: The elephant is a huge animal.
大象是一種體型龐大的動物。

en: To move your head down and up to say yes or to greet someone; or to almost fall asleep.
ex: She nodded her head to show that she agreed.
她點頭表示同意。

en: The state of being real or alive; or the fact that something exists.
ex: Scientists are searching for proof of life's existence on other planets.
科學家正在尋找其他行星上有生命存在的證據。

en: Almost the same but not exactly; having features in common.
ex: The two sisters have similar voices.
這兩姊妹的聲音很相似。

en: A vegetable of the onion family with a strong smell and taste, used in cooking.
ex: She added some garlic to the sauce.
她在醬汁中加了一些大蒜。

en: Located in or coming from the south part of a place; or a person from the south.
ex: The southern part of the island is warmer than the north.
島的南部比北部溫暖。

en: A person who plays a musical instrument or writes music, especially as a job.
ex: The musician played the piano beautifully.
那位音樂家把鋼琴彈得很美。

en: Coming at the end of a series; or the last game in a competition; or an exam at the end of a course.
ex: The final exam will be held next Friday.
期末考將在下星期五舉行。

en: A narrow way for walking, made by people or animals; or the direction something moves along.
ex: We followed the path through the forest.
我們沿著小路穿過森林。

en: More than the usual amount; or added to what is already there; or something added at an extra cost.
ex: Do you have an extra pen I could borrow?
你有多的筆可以借我嗎？

en: To cook food such as bread or cake in an oven; or to be very hot.
ex: She likes to bake cookies for her friends.
她喜歡為朋友烤餅乾。

en: A short piece of writing on a particular subject, especially by a student.
ex: We have to write an essay about our summer holiday.
我們得寫一篇關於暑假的作文。

en: The act of speaking to God; or words spoken in praying; or a strong request.
ex: She said a short prayer before dinner.
她在晚餐前做了簡短的禱告。

en: To be in charge of a business or team; or to succeed in doing something difficult; or to control something.
ex: She manages a small clothing shop downtown.
她在市中心經營一家小服飾店。

en: Intended to keep someone or something safe from harm; or acting to protect someone you love.
ex: Workers must wear protective gear on the building site.
工人在工地上必須穿戴防護裝備。

en: A short, sharp sound like a small explosion; or popular music; or a sweet fizzy drink; or to burst.
ex: The balloon popped with a loud bang.
氣球砰的一聲爆了。

en: To have something inside; or to have something as a part; or to control a feeling or a disease.
ex: This drink contains a lot of sugar.
這種飲料含有很多糖。

en: The organ inside your head that controls your thoughts, feelings and movements; or the ability to think.
ex: The brain controls everything we do.
大腦控制我們做的一切。

en: Involving more than one country; or relating to the relations between countries.
ex: The airport has many international flights every day.
這座機場每天有許多國際航班。

en: A part of a country with its own government, such as in the USA; or a condition; or to say something formally.
ex: California is a large state in the United States.
加州是美國的一個大州。

en: A white or gray bird, often used as a symbol of peace; or the past tense of dive (American).
ex: A white dove is a symbol of peace.
白鴿是和平的象徵。

en: Help or support given to someone; or something that helps; or to help.
ex: The nurse gave first aid to the injured boy.
護理師為受傷的男孩進行急救。

en: Something that is known by only a few people; or kept hidden from others; or the key to something.
ex: Can you keep a secret?
你能保守祕密嗎？

en: Happening often or at a fixed time; or normal and not special; or having an even shape.
ex: Regular exercise is good for your health.
規律的運動對健康有益。

en: The day before today; or the recent past.
ex: I went to the dentist yesterday.
我昨天去看牙醫。

en: A soft bag that you rest your head on in bed.
ex: She put a pillow under her head and fell asleep.
她把枕頭放在頭下就睡著了。

en: A thin piece of wood; or to fasten something with a sticky substance; or to push something pointed into something.
ex: He stuck a stamp on the envelope.
他在信封上貼了一張郵票。

en: To have a good opinion of someone; or to obey a rule or law; or admiration for someone.
ex: You should respect your teachers and parents.
你應該尊敬你的老師和父母。

en: A food made from grain, usually eaten with milk for breakfast; or a plant such as wheat or rice.
ex: I eat a bowl of cereal with milk every morning.
我每天早上吃一碗加牛奶的麥片。

en: A rubber bag filled with air or gas, often used as a toy or decoration; or to swell.
ex: The children blew up colorful balloons for the party.
孩子們為派對吹了彩色氣球。

en: A legal agreement between two people or companies; or to become smaller or shorter; or to get a disease.
ex: The company signed a contract with a famous builder.
公司與一位知名的建築商簽了合約。

en: Not special or different in any way; or the usual or standard kind.
ex: It was just an ordinary day at school.
這只是學校裡平凡的一天。

en: A piece of writing in lines that often rhyme and express feelings or ideas.
ex: She wrote a poem about her hometown.
她寫了一首關於家鄉的詩。

en: To cover a surface with a thin layer of something; or to open something out; or to move across an area.
ex: She spread butter on the bread.
她在麵包上塗了奶油。
